results.title: FG raised $500 million for Lagos airport after subsidy removal, Keyamo says
results.description: The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Management, Festus Keyamo, has said the removal of fuel and foreign exchange subsidies helped the administration of President Bola Tinubu raise about $500 million to reconstruct the Lagos airport and other aviation infrastructure within two years without borrowing. The post FG raised $500 million for Lagos airport after subsidy removal, Keyamo says appeared first on Nairametrics .
